summary: Required check `tests` is red on head cb49e208: `tests/oversight/test_secret_scan_validator_artifact.py::test_gate_passes_the_artifact_committed_on_main` (the PR's own AC-4) fails in CI. Root cause: the new suppression's condition 4 calls `git cat-file -e` on the artifact's head_sha, but `.github/workflows/tests.yml` uses `actions/checkout@v4` with no `fetch-depth`, so CI fetches `--depth=1` (confirmed in the job log) and `signoffs/validators/step1/summary.json`'s head_sha 8ed0daac (a 2026-08-03 commit) is absent from the shallow clone -- the finding is not suppressed and the gate exits 1. Fail-closed, so a reliability defect rather than a security hole, but it means the suppression silently stops working in any shallow checkout, i.e. #1754 is only fixed in full clones. Separately, non-required `oversight-gate-secret-scan` is red on this PR's own new test fixtures: line 203 (40-hex nested head_sha, no allowlist pragma) and line 464 (the planted AWS-key literal, whose `# pragma: allowlist secret` sits on line 465 -- the closing-paren line black wrapped it onto -- so detect-secrets never sees it on the finding's line). Note: `check_required_content_checks()` could not be run mechanically this cycle -- `get_branch_protection()` raises HTTP 403 (#1653/#1588, rulesets not branch protection); the required-context list was read from the rulesets API instead, where `tests` is required and `oversight-gate-secret-scan` is not.
